Project.NAME: yascheduler
Project.keywords: scheduler, SSH, cloud, HPC, AiiDA, orchestration
Project.annotation: Schedules scientific calculation jobs on SSH machines and cloud-created nodes.

M-MAIN.NAME: Package entry point
M-MAIN.purpose: Top-level package entry: re-exports Yascheduler client and path constants.

M-WEBHOOK.NAME: Webhook payload
M-WEBHOOK.purpose: Webhook payload frozen dataclass for webhook request serialization.

M-SCHEDULER.NAME: Scheduler
M-SCHEDULER.purpose: Backward-compatible thin wrapper: delegates to Orchestrator and use cases.
M-SCHEDULER.depends: M-DB, M-CLOUD-MANAGER, M-CONFIG, M-APPLICATION-ORCHESTRATOR, M-APPLICATION-SUBMIT, M-DI, M-WEBHOOK

class-Scheduler.PURPOSE: Backward-compatible async daemon wrapper (delegates to Orchestrator)

fn-get_logger.PURPOSE: Configure and return the yascheduler logger

fn-create.PURPOSE: Async factory: builds Scheduler with DB and clouds

fn-create_new_task.PURPOSE: Delegates to submit_task use case via DI

M-DB.NAME: Database layer
M-DB.purpose: PostgreSQL persistence for tasks, nodes, and their statuses.

class-DB.PURPOSE: Async PostgreSQL wrapper for tasks and nodes

fn-set_task_running.PURPOSE: Mark task RUNNING and bind to IP

fn-set_task_done.PURPOSE: Mark task DONE and update metadata

fn-set_task_error.PURPOSE: Mark task with error and optional message

M-CLIENT.NAME: Client API
M-CLIENT.purpose: Public Python/CLI client for submitting and querying tasks.

class-Yascheduler.PURPOSE: Sync/async client wrapper for task operations

fn-to_sync.PURPOSE: Decorator converting async function to sync

M-QUEUE.NAME: Unique queue
M-QUEUE.purpose: Deduplicating async queue for producer-consumer scheduling loops.

class-UniqueQueue.PURPOSE: Async queue that skips duplicate messages by ID

class-UMessage.PURPOSE: Typed message with ID and payload

M-AIIDA.NAME: AiiDA plugin
M-AIIDA.purpose: AiiDA scheduler plugin entry point for integrating with AiiDA workflows.

class-YaschedJobResource.PURPOSE: Resource class for yascheduler jobs in AiiDA

class-YaScheduler.PURPOSE: AiiDA Scheduler subclass for the yascheduler engine

M-VARIABLES.NAME: Project variables
M-VARIABLES.purpose: Global constants for config file, PID file, and log file paths.

M-UTILS.NAME: Utilities
M-UTILS.purpose: CLI entry points: submit, status, init, node management, daemonize.
M-UTILS.depends: M-CLIENT, M-CONFIG, M-DB, M-REMOTE, M-VARIABLES, M-DI, M-DOMAIN-MODEL

fn-submit.PURPOSE: Submit task to yascheduler via AiiDA script

fn-show_nodes.PURPOSE: Show enabled nodes and running tasks

M-TIME.NAME: Time utilities
M-TIME.purpose: Sleep utilities for sync and async contexts.

fn-asleep_until.PURPOSE: Async sleep until a given datetime

M-COMPAT.NAME: Compatibility
M-COMPAT.purpose: Type compatibility shims: Self and ParamSpec for older Python versions.

M-DAEMON-SYSTEMD.NAME: Systemd daemon
M-DAEMON-SYSTEMD.purpose: Systemd service entry point for the scheduler daemon.

M-DAEMON-SYSV.NAME: SysV daemon
M-DAEMON-SYSV.purpose: SysV init service entry point for launching the scheduler daemon.

fn-start_daemon.PURPOSE: SysV daemon entry point with PID file management

M-DOMAIN-EXCEPTIONS.NAME: Domain exceptions
M-DOMAIN-EXCEPTIONS.purpose: Domain exception hierarchy for business-level error handling.

class-DomainError.PURPOSE: Base class for all domain exceptions

class-MissingInputFileError.PURPOSE: Required engine input file not provided

class-TaskAlreadyAllocatedError.PURPOSE: Task already bound to a node

class-TaskNotAllocatedError.PURPOSE: Task not yet allocated to a node

class-MachineBusyError.PURPOSE: Operation attempted on a busy machine

class-NoCompatibleNodeError.PURPOSE: No matching node found for task

class-ProcessResult.PURPOSE: Exit code and captured output from remote execution

class-TaskContext.PURPOSE: Typed task metadata with arbitrary extras

class-Task.PURPOSE: Task entity with allocate_to, mark_running, complete, fail lifecycle

class-ConnectedMachine.PURPOSE: Runtime connected machine with is_compatible, occupy, release

M-DOMAIN-PORTS.NAME: Domain ports
M-DOMAIN-PORTS.purpose: Domain port interfaces: abstract contracts for persistence, machine operations, and cloud provisioning.

class-NodeRepository.PURPOSE: Async port for node persistence (full CRUD lifecycle)

class-MachineGateway.PURPOSE: Async port for remote machine operations

class-CloudProvisioner.PURPOSE: Async port for cloud node provisioning

fn-match_task_to_node.PURPOSE: Select first compatible free machine for a task, or None

M-APPLICATION-UOW.NAME: Abstract Unit of Work Protocol
M-APPLICATION-UOW.purpose: Protocol defining transactional boundary: tasks, nodes, commit, rollback.

class-AbstractUnitOfWork.PURPOSE: Async context manager Protocol with task and node repositories

M-APPLICATION-SUBMIT.NAME: Submit task use case
M-APPLICATION-SUBMIT.purpose: Validate engine/inputs, create domain Task, persist via UoW.

fn-submit_task.PURPOSE: Create a new TO_DO task after validating engine and inputs

M-APPLICATION-ALLOCATE.NAME: Allocate task use case
M-APPLICATION-ALLOCATE.purpose: Match a TO_DO task to a free machine or request cloud provisioning.

fn-allocate_task.PURPOSE: Assign a TO_DO task to a free machine or request cloud node

M-APPLICATION-CONSUME.NAME: Consume task use case
M-APPLICATION-CONSUME.purpose: Download outputs from remote machine and mark task DONE.

fn-consume_task.PURPOSE: Download task outputs and mark DONE or ERROR

M-APPLICATION-DEALLOCATE.NAME: Deallocate idle nodes use case
M-APPLICATION-DEALLOCATE.purpose: Disable idle cloud nodes and trigger VM deletion.

fn-deallocate_node.PURPOSE: Disconnect and cloud-deallocate a single node

fn-deallocate_nodes.PURPOSE: Disable idle cloud nodes and delete their VMs

M-APPLICATION-ORCHESTRATOR.NAME: Daemon Orchestrator
M-APPLICATION-ORCHESTRATOR.purpose: Manages producer-consumer loops calling use cases and SSH helpers.
M-APPLICATION-ORCHESTRATOR.depends: M-DB, M-REMOTE-REPO, M-CLOUD-MANAGER, M-CONFIG, M-QUEUE, M-TIME, M-APPLICATION-ALLOCATE, M-APPLICATION-CONSUME, M-APPLICATION-DEALLOCATE, M-WEBHOOK, M-SSH-GATEWAY

class-Orchestrator.PURPOSE: Daemon loop manager: connect machines, allocate, consume, deallocate

M-DI.NAME: Dependency Injection
M-DI.purpose: Composition root with factories per entry point: daemon, CLI, AiiDA.
M-DI.depends: M-APPLICATION-ORCHESTRATOR, M-APPLICATION-SUBMIT, M-APPLICATION-UOW, M-PERSISTENCE-UOW, M-CONFIG, M-DB, M-SSH-GATEWAY

class-CLIDeps.PURPOSE: Lightweight dependency container for CLI submit and query

fn-make_daemon.PURPOSE: Async factory creating Orchestrator with all daemon dependencies

M-PERSISTENCE.NAME: Persistence adapter entry point
M-PERSISTENCE.purpose: Persistence adapter package — re-exports from sql_loader, postgres, postgres_uow.

M-PERSISTENCE-SQLLOADER.NAME: SQL query loader
M-PERSISTENCE-SQLLOADER.purpose: SQL query file loader — reads .sql files with @functools.cache for pg8000 repositories.

fn-load_query.PURPOSE: Load SQL file contents by name with lru_cache

const-_SQL_DIR.PURPOSE: Path to the sql/ query directory

M-PERSISTENCE-EXCEPTIONS.NAME: Persistence exceptions
M-PERSISTENCE-EXCEPTIONS.purpose: Adapter-layer exceptions for persistence UoW state-contract violations.

class-UnitOfWorkNotInitializedError.PURPOSE: Raised when UoW methods called without entering context

M-PERSISTENCE-POSTGRES.NAME: PostgreSQL repositories
M-PERSISTENCE-POSTGRES.purpose: PostgresTaskRepository and PostgresNodeRepository implementing domain repository ports via pg8000.

class-PostgresTaskRepository.PURPOSE: PostgreSQL implementation of TaskRepository port (get, save, list_by_status, list_by_jobs, count_by_status)

class-PostgresNodeRepository.PURPOSE: PostgreSQL implementation of NodeRepository port (full CRUD lifecycle)

M-PERSISTENCE-UOW.NAME: PostgreSQL Unit of Work
M-PERSISTENCE-UOW.purpose: PostgresUnitOfWork managing shared pg8000 Connection across repositories with commit/rollback.

class-PostgresUnitOfWork.PURPOSE: Async context manager for transactional boundaries with shared connection

fn-_require_conn.PURPOSE: Guard returning Connection or raising UnitOfWorkNotInitializedError

M-CONFIG.NAME: Config root
M-CONFIG.purpose: Top-level configuration container aggregating all sub-configs.

class-Config.PURPOSE: Frozen config container parsed from INI file

M-CONFIG-LOCAL.NAME: Local config
M-CONFIG-LOCAL.purpose: Local daemon settings: concurrency limits, webhook config, sleep intervals.

class-ConfigLocal.PURPOSE: Local daemon concurrency and timing settings

M-CONFIG-REMOTE.NAME: Remote config
M-CONFIG-REMOTE.purpose: Remote machine defaults: data directories, SSH username, jump host.

class-ConfigRemote.PURPOSE: Remote machine path and SSH defaults

M-CONFIG-CLOUD.NAME: Cloud configs
M-CONFIG-CLOUD.purpose: Cloud provider configuration dataclasses: Azure, Hetzner, UpCloud.

class-ConfigCloud.PURPOSE: Union of all cloud config types

M-CONFIG-ENGINE.NAME: Engine config
M-CONFIG-ENGINE.purpose: Calculation engine definition: spawn command, check command, deployables, platforms.

type-Deploy.PURPOSE: Union type of all deploy configurations

M-CONFIG-ENGINE-REPO.NAME: Engine repository
M-CONFIG-ENGINE-REPO.purpose: Immutable collection of engines with filtering by platform.

class-EngineRepository.PURPOSE: Frozen dict of engines with filtering

M-CONFIG-UTILS.NAME: Config utilities
M-CONFIG-UTILS.purpose: Shared config helpers: field factories, validators, warning helpers.

fn-make_default_field.PURPOSE: attrs field factory with defaults and validators

M-CONFIG-HUB.NAME: Config re-export hub
M-CONFIG-HUB.depends: M-CONFIG, M-CONFIG-DB, M-CONFIG-LOCAL, M-CONFIG-REMOTE, M-CONFIG-CLOUD, M-CONFIG-ENGINE, M-CONFIG-ENGINE-REPO

M-CLOUD-API.purpose: Generic cloud provider interface: node creation, deletion, SSH key management.
M-CLOUD-API.depends: M-CLOUD-PROTOCOLS, M-CLOUD-ADAPTERS, M-CONFIG, M-REMOTE, M-CLOUD-UTILS, M-REMOTE-PROTOCOL

class-CloudAPI.PURPOSE: Generic cloud provider with create/delete/SSH key ops

fn-create_node.PURPOSE: Create VM, wait for SSH, setup node

fn-mk_machine.PURPOSE: Connect to existing IP as RemoteMachine

fn-get_ssh_key_sync.PURPOSE: Load SSH key for cloud provider

M-CLOUD-AZ.purpose: Azure VM creation and deletion using Azure SDK.

M-CLOUD-HETZNER.purpose: Hetzner Cloud server creation and deletion via API.

fn-hetzner_create_node.PURPOSE: Create Hetzner server and return IP

M-CLOUD-PROTOCOLS.purpose: Protocol definitions for cloud config, node creation, deletion callables.
